name: Shota Yuusha no Junan 4 ~Choi Defo-shiki Adventure Game~
original_name: ショタ勇者の受難4 ～ちょいデフォ式アドベンチャーゲーム～
source:
Everything's gone all chibi and weird! 

A shota hero is led by a (bad) goddess into 
the lair of a monster girl. 
Treasure is promised... somewhere. 
No! It's a trap! 

Into the super deformed cave we go. 
An ecchi ADV novel (lol) 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE166696.html]DLsite English[/url]]
